applicationPortal.value: Apply through Rice's Graduate Application portal for the Shepherd School Master of Music program. The Shepherd School Fall 2026 MM checklist lists application, unofficial transcripts from all previous institutions, unofficial TOEFL/IELTS/Duolingo score report if required, three letters of recommendation, and prescreening material as application requirements. All required application items and supplemental materials are due by December 1, 2025 at 11:59 p.m. Eastern Standard Time. Rice General Announcements confirms Piano Performance as an MMus degree field.

applicationFee.value: Application fee: $85 non-refundable application fee due December 1, 2025. Rice states that the application fee is payable by credit card or electronic check and that checks or money orders will not be accepted.

sources.label: Rice Shepherd Master of Music Checklist Fall 2026

auditionRequirements.value: Prescreening: an online prescreening submission is required by December 1, 2025 at 11:59 p.m. EST. Submission type: prescreening may be audio or video for MM Piano Performance. Audition format: auditions at the Shepherd School take place in person; Rice states there is no regional audition and that applicants living outside the United States may request an exception, but recorded auditions are granted only in special circumstances. Live audition dates: the MM Piano Performance audition page said audition dates would be posted soon at the time of review. Graduate FAQ note: applicants for MM degree programs are notified of results by April 1.

repertoireRequirements.value: Prescreening repertoire: Requirements for prescreening and audition are the same. Prescreening repertoire: Prepare a minimum of 45 minutes of memorized music. Prescreening repertoire: Program should include four of the following five style periods: Baroque; Classical; Romantic; Impressionist/Early 20th-century; Post-1950. Final audition repertoire: Requirements for prescreening and audition are the same. Final audition repertoire: Prepare a minimum of 45 minutes of memorized music. Final audition repertoire: Program should include four of the following five style periods: Baroque; Classical; Romantic; Impressionist/Early 20th-century; Post-1950.

deadlines.value: Application and supplemental materials deadline: December 1, 2025 at 11:59 p.m. Eastern Standard Time. Application fee deadline: December 1, 2025. Prescreening submission deadline: December 1, 2025. Recommendation letter deadline: December 10, 2025. English proficiency test deadline: January 3, 2026. Admission result timing: applicants for MM degree programs are notified by April 1.

englishScores.value: Applicability: applicants whose previous degree was not from a U.S. institution, or whose native language is not English, must submit an English proficiency test. Minimum scores: TOEFL iBT 90; Duolingo English Test 115; IELTS 7.0. TOEFL code: 6609. Timing: Fall 2026 English proficiency tests are due January 3, 2026. Exemptions: international applicants who received a degree from a U.S. institution, or whose primary language of instruction during the previous degree was English, are exempt from submitting TOEFL, IELTS, or Duolingo scores. Notes: for IELTS, select Rice University Graduate Admissions from the scoresheet options.

auditionRequirements.value: Program name: Rice lists this MMus field as Piano Chamber Music and Accompanying. Prescreening: an online prescreening submission is required by December 1, 2025 at 11:59 p.m. EST. Submission type: prescreening must be video for MM Piano Chamber Music and Accompanying. Audition timing: auditions will take place in January and February. Audition format: auditions at the Shepherd School take place in person; Rice states there is no regional audition and that applicants living outside the United States may request an exception, but recorded auditions are granted only in special circumstances. Final audition: sight-reading and interview may be required.

repertoireRequirements.value: Prescreening repertoire: A video recording of a chamber music or duo performance, at least 20 minutes in length. Prescreening repertoire: A solo piano work from memory, at least 10 minutes in length. Final audition repertoire: At least two solo works of different historical periods from memory. Final audition repertoire: An entire standard duo-sonata for piano and wind or string instrument. Final audition repertoire: Sight-reading and interview may be required.
